g.text: Μ METIS / A place for inquiry
Published prices, free-tier limits and data-use terms. Metis has not measured these
Free tier: 20 requests/day. Google shows free-tier limits per project in AI Studio, not
on a docs page; daily quotas reset at midnight Pacific time.
Data use: Free tier: Google uses prompts and responses to provide, improve and develop
its products, and human reviewers may read them; do not send confidential data. Paid
tier content is not used to improve products. Apps serving users in the EEA,
Switzerland or the UK must use paid services.
Provider description, not measured by Metis: Google describes it as its most
intelligent Flash model, for long-horizon software engineering and agents.
Promotional price through 2026-12-31; Google lists $1.50 input / $7.50 output from
gemini-flash-latest aliased this model in a live response on 2026-10-08.
Rate limits apply per Google Cloud project, not per key.
OpenAI compatibility is documented as beta; unsupported parameters are ignored.
Ctrl+K commands · Navigate with Tab / arrows · Enter selects
